source_retrieval.git: Clone each listed source repository without credentials; git checkout --detach <resolved_commit or ref>; git submodule update --init --recursive. Never use --remote: the listed superproject commit fixes submodule gitlinks.
svn: svn export --username anonymous --password '' -r 2204 https://svn.xvid.org/trunk/xvidcore@2204 xvidcore-2204. This is the upstream public anonymous account, not a user credential.
source_retrieval.rust: The listed .crate files are the source archives named by upstream Cargo.lock, with their expected SHA256. Lockfile superset includes optional/dev/build crates to avoid omitting runtime code.
source_retrieval.patches: Apply the exact inline edits and patches from the bundled BtbN build snapshot; unmodified source archives alone do not include those changes.

build_tool_note.cc: rav1e lists cc under [build-dependencies]. It is an unmodified general-purpose Cargo build helper that invokes the native C compiler; GPLv3 section 1 excludes generally available free build tools not part of the executable work. Its precise historical compiler/helper version is not claimed here.
build_tool_note.cargo_update: Cargo documents cargo update <spec> as a conservative single-package update; other locked packages stay locked unless required transitively. The recipe operation is retained verbatim; this source plan does not claim bit-identical rebuilding.
build_tool_note.limits: Historical build-tool identity is separate from actual linked source. If evidence shows a runtime crate was changed transitively, update its source entry before publishing.

source_delivery: GPLv3 6(d): the exact source archives/repositories, fixed refs, Rust source checksums and original build/patch materials listed here are available with equivalent public copying access. Clear directions must accompany the binary download; distributor must keep access available and mirror any source that disappears.

pyav_ffmpeg_vendor.patches: Exact patches and source edits are in the preserved builder snapshot; scripts/pkg.py supplies all source archive SHA256 values.
pyav_ffmpeg_vendor.source_scope: Superset of all vendor build platforms; Linux-only and NASM tool sources are included for clarity.

gcc_runtimes.license: GPL-3.0-or-later with GCC Runtime Library Exception; unmodified compiler runtime libraries are separate from application-linked third-party codec source.

license_materials.scope: Source recipe/lockfile superset includes optional and build-only components, which are not necessarily redistributed linked code.
